target.name: Braxusx/FarCry2VR local contribution: compile-gated scenario runner

question: Can an opt-in debug scenario plan require downstream swap/rearm/pose/capture observations while retaining the production input authority boundary and excluding its control payload from the normal build?
claim: The inspected source injects only raw synthetic controller evidence before the normal pose cache and rearm gates, observes rather than fabricates owner/palette/pad state, and requires correlated stereo files. Bounded harness cases reject requested-but-unobserved swaps, missing downstream callbacks or captures and incorrect rearm. Three rebuilt mutants fail assertions. Full x86 debug and normal DLLs compile; the arming strings/debug symbols are absent from the normal DLL. This confirms source mechanisms and harness controls only, not native execution, game pixels, worker lifetimes or visual acceptance.
method: CMake/MSBuild 18.5.4 Win32 Release: 57 CTest groups, 114095 C++ assertions, six source-wiring guards and six Python receipt-control methods. GCC 16.2.0 MSYS2 Rev3 x86: seven new groups, 30160 assertions, -Wall -Wextra -Werror. Rebuilt isolated mutants remove weapon-change evidence, capture acknowledgement or eye-pair equality and fail the intended tests. mod/build-local.ps1 built both final PE32 variants and checked DirectInput8Create plus arming-token/debug-symbol inclusion/exclusion. Both retain 31 prior warning messages. Python 3.12.3 verifies file/hash/frame/source/owner/palette and saved physical-authority correlation with harness-labelled temporary fixtures. The registered in-house receipt template was initialized in ignored build, then the donor identity was used for standalone validation; no fleet or remote writes.

identity.reason: Full implementation commit, stamped source/tests and exact output DLL sizes/hashes identify the inspected/built artifacts.

instrument.reason: Nonempty production-helper harness output, source-topology checks, compiler/PE/export/profile checks and expected assertion failures were inspected. No game was run.

control.reason: Complete modelled observations succeed; absent swap, poll, applied pose or capture cannot complete. Broken swap/capture/pair variants fail. Receipt tests reject missing/end/eye/file/hash/frame/source/owner and held-rearm errors.

scene.reason: Offline source/harness task. No native scene, HMD, OpenXR runtime session or actual game image was tested.

restore.reason: Persistent local contribution changes. Mutants stay isolated under ignored build and never enter either DLL. No deployment, runtime switch or game process required restoration.

baseline.reason: The existing and new offline groups and both x86 builds pass. This is not an in-game or headset baseline; those were not measured.

limits: Native input acceptance, swap/menu setup, palette/job lifetime and actual rendering were not exercised. Callback/palette receipts do not prove a skinning consumer. Synthetic tracked evidence is explicitly test input, not physical controller tracking. Capture is synchronous, bounded and pre-DLSS; it may cause a freshness timeout and does not validate compositor output. AFW skipped eyes are not substituted. Legacy calibration provenance, exact GOG profile, authoritative reload acknowledgement and HMD wrist/elbow acceptance remain open. No manual reload, steering or DQS feature was added. ArmRigFix remains default-off.

do_not_repeat.approach: Treat emitted input, elapsed waits, a requested screenshot or a completion marker alone as a successful game playtest
do_not_repeat.reason: Missing native swap/poll/pose/capture observations and broken image correlations are independently rejected by these offline controls.
do_not_repeat.reopen_when: Target-proved native consumption, same-run real image evidence and appropriate visual/headset acceptance replace the current harness-only boundary.

next_action: Keep local. Separately authorize a safe disposable-save native run, verify the loaded exact-image/debug markers, then exercise one scenario and inspect both-eye artifacts and callback timing. Do not clear ownership/visual/manual-reload gates from harness success. Fleet intake is deferred because the donor root is unregistered and the user requested local-only work.
